items.q: What does this actually do for my restaurant?
items.a: We turn your invoices and sales into a weekly report on food cost: where you are losing money and what to change. You do not log into software or type anything in.

items.q: Do I have to enter any data?
items.a: No. You send a photo or forward an email. We read it, a person checks every line, and we handle the rest.

items.q: How does the free audit work?
items.a: You send one week of invoices and a sales report. We show you the gap between what you spent and what your recipes say you should have spent, and the top five reasons for it.
Core is $500 a month and you can cancel anytime. The audit is free.
Yes. AI does the first read of your invoices, but a person verifies every line and answers your texts the same day.

items.q: Is the restaurant on this site real?
items.a: No. This is a demo with sample data for a fictional restaurant, so you can see what the weekly report and screens look like.
